# technitium_app (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_app` manages, without managing it, found by `name`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The app name, for example `Split Horizon`. Changing it replaces the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `update_available` (Boolean) Whether the DNS App Store has a newer version.
- `update_version` (String) The newest version in the DNS App Store.
- `version` (String) The installed version.
